notes.title: [1.1.2] Minor balances and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Fixed some bugs and made some balance changes in this patch.



Stopped enemy bodies from stretching most of the time

Increased the amount of food given from farms and barns

Decreased the random spawn gap dramatically

Slightly decreased difficulty curve



We are working on a pretty big gameplay update, so minor bugs fixes and changes will be rolled out slower.

notes.title: Very Small Hotfix
notes.notes: Should have fixed an issue with leaderboard scores not uploading

notes.title: June 26 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Well, a launch wouldn't be complete without finding some bugs right after.



Fixed a balance issue with archers

Fixed a bug that wouldn't erase your save after losing (which also caused a crash when loading the game)

Tweaked starting resources to be a bit more balanced

Fixed a glitch that wouldn't have enemies spawn after saving

notes.title: In-game Resource Update and Thank you
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



We’ve got a two announcements to share today as we approach release day!



In play testing we have found that Stone and Wood resources felt clunky and incomplete. We feel that in its current state it overcomplicates the game. We apologize for such late notice of this, but we don’t want to release an incomplete feature. Do not worry though, as we plan to bring Stone and Wood back in a later update. As you can see by this amazing graph, we predict Tiny Kings’ awesomeness level to increase as more updates are pushed out!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/370714fa238628f5afff7349658871a95c5d207b.jpg"]



The second announcement is something I am very grateful for.
Tiny Kings has over 100 wishlists! I want to thank you for all the support, it really means a lot. From humble beginnings as a game-jam game to a full release on Steam. Creating and expanding Tiny Kings had been a great journey! On behalf of the team, I thank you all for your support and can’t wait to see your kingdoms and hear your feedback.
